title: XXE-Prone XML Parsing
pattern: Parsing XML documents using a parser configuration that permits resolving XML External Entities (XXE) and external DTD declarations.
why_bad: Enables Local File Inclusion (LFI) and SSRF. Attackers can submit XML files containing custom entity declarations pointing to local system directories (like `/etc/passwd`), forcing the parser to load and exfiltrate host file contents.
detection: Configuration calls setting `enable_external_entities` or similar XML parser parameter variables to `true` prior to parsing external payloads.
fix: Configure all XML parsing libraries to explicitly disable XXE resolution and external DTD definitions before processing untrusted data.
source: `Heather Adkins et al. - Building Secure and Reliable Systems (2020)`, Ch 12, p. 252.
